description: This file defines data access functions for managing 'Step' records in a database using SQLAlchemy ORM, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting steps associated with experiments.

methods.name: List[Step] list_steps_for_experiment(db: Session, experiment_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of steps associated with a specific experiment, ordered by 'order_index' and 'id'.

methods.name: Step create_step(db: Session, experiment_id: int, name: str, type: str | None, order_index: int, notes: str | None)
methods.description: Creates a new step record for a given experiment and returns the created Step object.

methods.name: Optional[Step] update_step(db: Session, step_id: int, name: str | None, type: str | None, order_index: int | None, notes: str | None)
methods.description: Updates an existing step record with new values; returns the updated Step or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_step(db: Session, step_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a step by its ID; returns True if successful, False otherwise.

ctags.name: create_step
ctags.pattern: /^def create_step(db: Session, experiment_id: int, name: str, type: str | None, order_index: int, /
ctags.signature: (db: Session, experiment_id: int, name: str, type: str | None, order_index: int, notes: str | None)

ctags.name: update_step
ctags.pattern: /^def update_step(db: Session, step_id: int, name: str | None, type: str | None, order_index: int /
ctags.signature: (db: Session, step_id: int, name: str | None, type: str | None, order_index: int | None, notes: str | None)
